objectives: “本課內容主要為關於光波的一般知識,其間特別加強其與傅氏光學和晶體光學相關之處,使得學生有一個較強固的基礎去修讀前述兩門本所的核心課程.“
content:
1. Vector analysis
2. Maxwell equations
3. Wave equations and plane wave solution
4. Reflection and refraction of plane waves
5. Guided waves
6. Radiation
books:
“1. Paul Lorrain, Dale R. Corson, Electromagnetic Fields and Waves (New York : W.H. Freeman, c2000)
2. David K. Cheng, Field and Wave Electromagnetics , 2nd ed.  (Addison-Wesley,
1989).
3. M.A. Heald and J.B. Marion, Classical electromagnetic radiation 3rd Ed.(Saunders College Publishing)
4. 自寫講義“
grading_policy: “本課包含三次考試及平時習作, 學期總成績由此四項成績相加而得,各佔四分之一“

distribution_conditions.rule: 系所:限光電科學與工程學系碩士在職專班。
